purpose: Accumulated continuity history across ALL episodes ever produced. This is different from current_state.json (which only tracks what's currently active) and last_episode.json (which only tracks the single most recent episode). world_state.json is the append-only long-term memory that lets the pipeline avoid continuity errors across hundreds of future episodes. See phase1/docs/governance/authority_rules.md.

char_001_zayd.lesson: Kindness to parents brings closeness to Allah

char_002_amira.lesson: Morning dua sets a good start to the day

seasonal_state.notes: Set to 'ramadan' or 'eid' during seasonal specials per festivals.json; reset to 'none' otherwise.

update_instructions: MASTER_PROMPT.md Step 20 (Produce Final Output) must append to this file after every successfully packaged episode: add any new lesson to character_lessons_learned for characters who grew in that episode, increment recurring_locations_used for the environment(s) used, and append {episode_id, topic_id, published_at} to episode_chronology. Never overwrite prior entries — this file is append-only, consistent with deprecation_policy.md. Also append/update concepts_taught for every concept_id used in the episode (increment times_used, set last_used_episode, append the difficulty level used) — this is the Moral Progression check: MASTER_PROMPT.md Step 16 must consult this before selecting a concept so the same moral isn't retaught at the same difficulty repeatedly (see phase4/engine/teaching/teaching_strategy.json for how difficulty maps to age).

metadata.pattern_conflict_tracking_added: 2026-08-05 — real gap found: world_state.json previously tracked concept usage only, with no field for pattern/conflict usage across concepts. This is why 3 different concepts independently defaulted to pattern_002 without any mechanism able to detect the collision. Backfilled from the 13 real episodes generated so far in this project's history.
